title: Food & Agro-Processing Micro-Enterprises
description: Small-scale food and agricultural processing livelihood opportunities in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh (spice processing, pickle making, cold-pressed oils, millet processing, seed processing, general food processing).
scope_note: Investment figures are PENDING_VERIFICATION unless traced to a specific government DIC/MSME/PMFME/KVIC project profile; qualitative context for unverified figures is in `notes`.
